beforeExpiryRetryDailyUntilDue: before expiry; retry daily until due date. Switch to pay-as-you-go if payment fails.
payAOneTimeFixedFee: Pay a one-time fixed fee for a long-term commitment to reserve stable, dedicated resources.
payAsYouGoWithCosts: Pay as you go,with costs based on actual usage time.
spotInstancesOfferLowPricesBut: Spot instances offer low prices but may be interrupted at any time. The system will notify 1 hour in advance. A 1-hour protection period is applied by default. Best suited for fault-tolerant tasks.
